title: Request Snapshot Studio — compact drilldown for spans, correlations, and filters
creator: Aisha Raman
description:
Goal: Design a compact, shareable 'Request Snapshot Studio' UI pattern for the Console that lets engineers take a single-request snapshot and quickly traverse spans, correlation IDs, timeline scrubbing, and contextual filters without leaving the dashboard flow. This ticket contains the prototype, design rationale, and responses to engineering/PM review.

Problem space: current trace drilldowns require two-panel heavy UIs and lose context when jumping between requests. Platform teams want a faster time-to-diagnosis flow that is deep-linkable (shareable URL to a specific span/time), lightweight for on-call use, and composable into other Console surfaces (rollouts, cost views, alerts).

Deliverables: 1) High-fidelity Figma prototype of the Snapshot Studio (desktop + tablet) with keyboard-first navigation; 2) Interaction spec for deep links, snapshot permalinks, and correlation pinning; 3) Accessibility checklist and edge-case handling notes; 4) Usability test plan and sample task results.
comments: 2026-03-06 - Initial prototype sketched: compact left span column, center timeline scrubber, right detail flyout. Shared to #console-design for early feedback.

2026-03-07 - PM review (Connor Li): asked for strong deep-linking semantics (span-id + timestamp + pinned-correlation) and ability to attach snapshots to incidents. Action: add permalinks and 'attach to incident' CTA in header.
2026-03-09 - Eng sync (Ravi Patel): feasible with existing trace store; recommended backend flag to generate stable snapshot tokens for perms. Blocking: ENG-6512 to add snapshot API endpoint.

2026-03-10 - Design review with UX research (Marisol Ortega): added keyboard nav flows and compacted span row density for 1200px width. Ran 3 quick moderated sessions (internal); participants found scrubber and mini-map useful but confused by correlation pin UX.

2026-03-12 - Updated prototype with clarified correlation pin (toggle + keyboard shortcut 'P') and added hover tooltips that explain pinned filters. Uploaded Figma v3 and added prototype link to attachments.
2026-03-13 - Ready for PM sign-off. Noted follow-ups: a11y color contrast fixes and aria-live regions for timeline scrubber updates.
design_decisions: Snapshot as first-class object: snapshots are immutable view tokens (span-id, timestamp, pinned-filters) that can be shared and attached to incidents.

Compact layout: left column = collapsed span list (one-line rows with icons for errors/warnings), center = timeline + mini-map scrubber, right = expandable details panel that slides over rather than replacing view.
Correlation pinning: UI affordance to pin a correlation ID to the snapshot. Pinning narrows spans across the snapshot and is encoded in the permalink.
Progressive disclosure: by default, only top-level spans shown; expand toggles reveal nested spans. Hover reveals quick actions (open span raw JSON, copy trace link, jump to logs).
Deep-linking: URL params support snapshot_token and tl=timestamp to open any snapshot state directly; design includes fallback UX for expired tokens.
Integrations: contextual CTA to jump into Rollouts view when snapshot shows a recent deployment span (deploy metadata visible inline).
ux_notes: Keyboard-first: row focus with arrow keys, 'Enter' to open details, 'P' to pin correlation, '/' to search spans by name, 'G' then 'T' to go to timeline timepicker.
Accessibility: ensure scrubber has aria-valuemin/valuemax and aria-valuenow; timeline updates are announced to screen readers via aria-live; color treatment tested at 4.5:1 contrast.
Responsive behavior: on narrow widths (<960px) hide mini-map and collapse details into a bottom sheet; maintain deep-link behavior.
Performance: limit initial span renders to first 200 spans with 'load more' to avoid rerender jank for very deep traces.
Edge cases: expired snapshot token shows a 'Restore latest' button and preserves pinned filters where possible; if correlation pin matches no spans, show 'No matches' state with suggested filters.
Testing: include synthetic traces with long tail (>1000 spans), high concurrency, and cross-region correlation IDs for validation during engineering implementation.
review_feedback: Connor Li (PM): please ensure snapshots are attachable to incidents and include a small summary card (latency, error rate, top-span).
Ravi Patel (Eng): backend needs stable snapshot tokens and an API to resolve token -> trace window. ENG-6512 created; dependency noted. Also requested JSON export for span details.
Angela Meyer (SRE): requested 'pin-by-deployment' suggestion when traces contain a deploy span within last 30 minutes to aid fast rollback decisions.
Accessibility note (UX Research): ensure keyboard trap avoidance when the details panel is open; add clear focus ring for on-call usage.
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype includes desktop and tablet variants, with documented keyboard flows.
Prototype demonstrates deep-linking with snapshot_token and pinned-correlation in URL.
Design spec contains all states: empty/no-match, expired token, large-span-count, and mobile sheet behavior.
UX research: at least 5 moderated sessions with internal engineers and documented takeaways; top 3 usability issues addressed.
Handoff notes to Eng: asset export, CSS tokens, and a component map for left span list, timeline, and details panel.
PM sign-off recorded in comments and linked to PM-718 for productization scope.
